exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

clear summer morning, fog lifting off the bay
late july sunset stretching past eight

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap dissolving fog pockets over a bay to reveal shipping lanes — each cleared patch chains into the next route before the mist rolls back in.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each pocket pops open with a soft reveal and the next lane lights up instantly
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog regenerates faster and pockets shrink as wind picks up

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick spent rocket stages into deorbit arcs before they clutter low earth orbit — every clean burn leaves a brighter sky streak.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: stages arc and burn up in satisfying neon trails
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more debris spawns and reentry windows tighten each wave

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Place reward crumbs on a grid and watch a tiny agent learn your path in real time — it reroutes mid-round as you adjust the trail.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: seeing the agent adapt within the same 60-second run
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: maze walls shift and agent speed ramps each wave

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort gusts into bins to keep a hot-air balloon level above rolling summer hills — wrong bins tilt the basket toward the ground.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: balloon rights itself with each correct sort in one fluid motion
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: gusts arrive faster with conflicting directions as heat rises
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: warm amber dusk gradient over soft hills
